title: MOSAIC: Masked Outsourcing of Secure AI Computations
abstract: arXiv:2607.29221v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We address the challenge of securely and efficiently outsourcing AI computations from a trusted but computationally weak client to an untrusted but powerful server, in the setting where the client holds both the input and the model, and the server must learn neither. We present MOSAIC, whose core is a novel matrix-multiplication masking protocol that scales to far larger matrices than prior work, enabling the safe outsourcing of modern workloads such as large transformer inference. By introducing small amounts of noise to the multiplication result and thereby relaxing correctness, MOSAIC achieves optimal asymptotic client overhead and concrete runtimes orders of magnitude faster than prior work. Its security reduces to the decisional LWE and LPN assumptions. translated_title: MOSAIC：安全AI计算的可掩蔽外包
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.29221v2 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：我们解决了将AI计算从可信但计算能力弱的客户端安全且高效地外包给不可信但强大的服务器这一挑战，在客户端同时持有输入和模型，而服务器不得学习任何内容的场景下。我们提出了MOSAIC，其核心是一种新颖的矩阵乘法掩蔽协议，该协议可扩展到比先前工作大得多的矩阵，从而能够安全地外包现代工作负载，如大型Transformer推理。通过向乘法结果引入少量噪声并因此放宽正确性，MOSAIC实现了最优的渐近客户端开销和比先前工作快数量级的具体运行时间。其安全性归约到决策性LWE和LPN假设。由于这种噪声在Transformer的许多层中累积，一个关键技术挑战是限制误差增长；MOSAIC通过一种误差缩放机制解决了这一问题。
tldr: MOSAIC提出了一种新型矩阵乘法掩蔽协议，通过引入少量噪声实现安全高效的外包AI计算，显著降低了客户端开销并加速运行时间，同时通过误差缩放机制有效控制Transformer多层中的误差累积。
en_tdlr: MOSAIC introduces a novel matrix-multiplication masking protocol that enables secure and efficient outsourcing of AI computations by adding minimal noise, achieving optimal client overhead and orders-of-magnitude speedup, while managing error growth via an error-scaling mechanism.
